strengths: AtomicU64 key generation — no lock contention, no UUID dependency
GIL correctly released in ALL 4 py.detach() calls
Zero unwrap/expect/unsafe — safest adapter so far
Clean 4-method protocol matching Letta VectorStore interface
weaknesses: list_memories truncates at 100 records (same bug as mem0 delete_col)
retrieve_memory returns raw distance score without normalization
AtomicU64 counter resets on restart — potential key collision
Test coverage thin (5 tests, no error paths)
No delete_col/reset — no way to clear a user's memories
comparison: Second-best adapter after mem0. Cleaner than openai/ollama/litellm (AtomicU64 over RwLock, no metadata type confusion). But simpler protocol means fewer surface issues to find.
